'''Cave Flies (dangerous)''' are an [[Monsters|enemy]] found in [[The Mines]] after activating the [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Shrine of Challenge]] or during the [[Quests#Danger In The Deep|Danger In The Deep]] quest. 80 cave insects (any type) need to be killed for the [[Adventurer's Guild#Monster Eradication Goals|Monster Eradication Goal]] at the [[Adventurer's Guild]].

[[Grub (dangerous)|Dangerous Grubs]] hatch into Dangerous Cave Flies shortly after entering their cocoon phase, during which time they are invulnerable.

==Behavior==
They will fly towards the player (including through walls) at high speeds and deal damage on contact. They will then loop around for another pass.

==Strategy==
Stand still and swing with a weapon that has high knockback right before the fly makes contact.

==History==
{{History|1.5|Introduced.}}
{{History|1.6|Changed Monster Eradication Goal for cave insects from 125 to 80.}}
